description.narrative:
Delivering lifesaving food assistance to vulnerable groups affected by drought and conflict in Ethiopia.
The UN predicts, that over 28 million people will be in need of humanitarian assistance in Ethiopia in 2023. The country has already seen a significant increase in malnutrition amongst children especially in areas affected by conflict and drought, and additional funding is necessary for WFP to continue their response to the emergencies in Ethiopia. The allocation of 26 million DKK will contribute to WFP’s unconditional emergency food and nutrition assistance in conflict-affected regions as well as the organization’s drought responses across the country.
Due to its nature as a response to a humanitarian appeal operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
